name: Payroll Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Payroll on Steam now!

 

Mobile requires a controller!

The dice roguelike. Payroll is a compulsively replayable deckbuilder where you rotate dice to control luck, discover devastating combos, and trigger outrageous chain reactions to escape the loan shark.

 

Roll Dice. Rotate Your Fate. Escape the Loan Shark.

 

One forgotten parking ticket spiraled out of control.
Now a literal loan shark is after you—and he’s not taking excuses.

 

Your only hope?
A dangerous deal involving magical dice and a ticking clock.

 

🎲 CONTROL THE CHAOS

 

This isn’t a luck game—it’s about turning bad rolls into perfect plays.

 

Roll your dice, then rotate them to visible faces to shape the outcome. Dice land at angles, limiting your options. Positioning matters. Every rotation is a choice—and every choice can save or doom your run.

 

🧩 BUILD YOUR DICE, YOUR WAY

 

You don’t start powerful—you build power.
Customize your dice between rounds:
Add new faces
Create satisfying combos
Discover wild synergies
Turn scraps into momentum
Every upgrade changes how your dice behave, and every decision carries risk.

 

🦈 THE LOAN SHARK IS WATCHING

 

Clear your debts and the rules start to bend.
Special rounds introduce brutal twists:
Dice may lock up
Rotations can be restricted
Familiar strategies stop working
Adapt fast—or get eaten.

 

🔁 A TRUE ROGUELIKE FEEL

 

Every run starts fresh.
No safety nets. No guarantees. Just your choices and the dice.

 

Short, punchy runs make it dangerously easy to say: “Okay… one more.”

 

📺 RETRO PS1 AESTHETIC
